_doc: Proprietary Alt-ID Kinds exempt from altidtool-format rule 6 (a second IsSameAs of one Kind with a different value is a conflict). Read through eidr_core.altidtool_io.multi_form_domains(). A Kind is (type, domain AS THE REGISTRY STORES IT): 'trakt.tv', 'trakt.tv/movies' and 'trakt.tv/shows' are three Kinds. Declared, not derived: the uri_mapping.json derivation of v1.3 was measured wrong on 2026-09-26 (duplicate entries are alternate URL templates of ONE form, e.g. wikidata.org x5, dfi.dk/movie x3; and trakt.tv's numeric and slug forms are separate registry Kinds, not one).
criterion: Two bases, each entry naming its own. 'measured' (the default when an entry names none): a Kind is listed when at least half of the registry records that carry it hold MORE THAN ONE identity value of it (relation NULL, '' or IsSameAs); the registry's own practice then says the Kind is multi-valued by design, and a rule-6 conflict there would contradict it. The next Kinds down were 14.2% (disney.com/mpm-p) and 11.6% (sho.com/editid), a clear break from 79.7%. 'ruled': the operator rules a Kind two-form when its identifiers come in two forms that cannot be told apart from outside the registrant; the entry quotes the ruling, gives its date, and records the measurement taken when it was made, so a later review can see what was known.
method_sql: WITH ident AS (SELECT content_id, id_type, lower(coalesce(domain,'')) AS dom, alt_id FROM content_alternate_ids WHERE relation IS NULL OR relation = '' OR relation = 'IsSameAs'), per AS (SELECT id_type, dom, content_id, count(DISTINCT alt_id) AS n FROM ident GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT id_type, dom, count(*) AS records, count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 1) AS multi FROM per GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 1) > 0 ORDER BY multi DESC

domains.ruling: Operator, 2026-10-02: "We can't tell, so accept both for now." Provisional: reviewed if Mediafilm says the two forms are one identifier or that one is retired.
domains.note: Measured on the mirror 2026-10-02. The two forms use DISJOINT number ranges, so a numeric value is not the digits of an mf-tt value: they are two identifier schemes, and the published URL template (mediafilm.ca/en/films/{0}) returns 404 for both, so the site cannot settle which is current. 3 records hold one of each; none holds two values of one form. Raised by BMRtoAltID T6 (77 of 731 rows: a numeric value against a record holding mf-tt-...). The separate Kind mediafilm.ca/film (727 values, all mf-tt) is single-form and NOT listed.
